title: Kontext routing policy
text: Kontext routes deterministic date and time questions to the runtime clock. Stable explanations use the direct model route. Fresh, current, cited, or explicitly searched questions use web evidence. Uploaded files use document retrieval, and prior conversation questions use scoped memory.

title: Kontext streaming contract
text: The chat stream uses named SSE events including request.accepted, route.decision, plan.created, step.started, source.discovered, answer.token, answer.sources, request.completed, and request.failed. Partial answers and sources should remain available when a later tool fails.

title: Kontext evaluation gate
text: The evaluation gate checks route correctness, evidence grounding, citation behavior, persistence, fallback handling, and UI stream completion. Deterministic smoke tests must run without API keys or provider credentials.
